name: Southern Gate
description: Nantianmen, the main entrance to heaven, has appeared in mythological stories such as "Journey to the West", "The Romance of the Gods", "The Legend of the White Snake", and "Nezha Cao Hai". Legend has it that it is the entrance from the human world to the fairy world, and is often guarded and protected by heavenly soldiers and generals, so people believe that crossing it leads to happiness. Pinku Nantianmen is majestic and auspicious. When placed in the home, it can not only decorate the space, but also have the meaning of eliminating Mercury retrograde and blessing peace.
